Class KfeRemoteFinancialTransactionApprovalClient

java.lang.Object

All Implemented Interfaces:
com.kerosene.common.financial.approval.FinancialTransactionApprovalPort
@Component @Profile("kfe") @ConditionalOnProperty(name="kfe.remote.transaction-approval.enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) public class KfeRemoteFinancialTransactionApprovalClient extends Object implements com.kerosene.common.financial.approval.FinancialTransactionApprovalPort

      restTemplateFactory - factory producing mTLS/SPIFFE or legacy client
